blocks.label: SCENE CONTEXT
blocks.zh: 场景上下文：以角色计数头开篇（如 EXACT 3 CHARACTERS — NO DUPLICATES），后接场景动作与角色行
blocks.en: Opens with a count header (EXACT 3 CHARACTERS — NO DUPLICATES), then scene action and character lines

blocks.label: GEO SPATIAL LAYOUT
blocks.zh: 地理空间布局：纯场景平面图（地标、左右、相机站位、180° 轴线），不含角色与动作；每场锁定逐镜粘贴不变
blocks.en: Pure floor plan of the place (landmarks, left/right, camera side, 180° axis); no characters, no action; locked across every shot of the scene

blocks.label: ACTION TIMING
blocks.zh: 动作时间线：0.0-2.0s 逐秒动作；镜头运动写进动作；INNER (unspoken) 内心独白；分阶段眨眼与微表情
blocks.en: Per-second action timeline; camera written inside the action; INNER (unspoken) monologue; phased blinking and micro-expressions

blocks.label: AUDIO
blocks.zh: 对白与音效：台词只存在于 AUDIO 块；音色锁定描述符原样粘贴；写明混音（人声近麦、环境底噪、说话时压低）
blocks.en: Dialogue lives only here; voice descriptor pasted verbatim; write the mix (voices close, ambience under, dips when someone speaks)

blocks.label: CHARACTER ACTING
blocks.zh: 角色表演：情绪状态·此刻所求·隐瞒之物·身体节奏·可见习惯·本镜变化；核心行为段永不改变
blocks.en: Emotional state · want in this moment · what they hide · body rhythm · visible habits · what changes across the shot

blocks.label: STYLE
blocks.zh: 风格前缀：逐字粘贴（Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 12s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.）
blocks.en: Style prefix pasted word for word (Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 12s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.)

blocks.label: POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
blocks.zh: 正向锁定：8K 细节、毛孔级皮肤、无抖动闪烁；计数物体以「是什么在画面中」表述；点名失败镜头长什么样
blocks.en: Positive locks: 8K detail, pore-level skin, no jitter; counted objects phrased as what IS in frame; name what a failed shot looks like

blocks.label: LONG DIALOGUE HANDLING
blocks.zh: 长台词 7 手法（T1-T7）：T1 拆成「问—答」两镜；T2 台词前置动作镜垫一句；T3 用听者反应镜打断；T4 边走边说（运动消解时长）；T5 插入物件特写（手/道具）；T6 同一句拆到两句台词块（在自然停顿处）；T7 允许镜头内保留但把长句写成「呼吸分段的短句群」。单镜台词上限：中文 ≤ 40 字 / 英文 ≤ 25 词
blocks.en: Seven techniques for over-long dialogue (T1-T7): T1 split into question/reply shots; T2 pre-line an action shot; T3 cut to listener reaction; T4 walk-and-talk; T5 insert a prop close-up; T6 split one sentence at a natural pause into two AUDIO blocks; T7 keep in-shot but rewrite as breath-separated short clauses. Per-shot dialogue ceiling: 40 CJK chars / 25 English words

blocks.label: ACTION CHOREOGRAPHY
blocks.zh: 动作戏编排 17 条要点：①一镜一动作 ②动作必须有终点姿态 ③避免多人同时动作 ④打击点在画面外的处理 ⑤用尘土/碎屑/衣物摆动承接冲击 ⑥不在同一镜内改变空间关系 ⑦快速动作配慢速镜头 ⑧反转动作需两镜（起势/落点）⑨手持感只靠轻微晃动 ⑩避免肢体交叠（易粘连）⑪武器走向写在动作句内 ⑫受击反应放在下一切点 ⑬慢动作只用于强调帧 ⑭同一动作不跨镜重复 ⑮环境反馈（风、雨、火）作为动作的一部分 ⑯落地/起身需要独立镜 ⑰动作结束后留 0.3s 静止
blocks.en: Seventeen action-choreography points: one action per shot; every action ends in a settled pose; avoid simultaneous multi-character action; handle impact outside frame; carry impact with dust/debris/cloth; never change spatial relations inside one shot; pair fast action with slow camera; reversals need two shots (windup/landing); handheld only via slight sway; avoid limb overlap (smearing); put weapon direction inside the action sentence; reaction lands on the next cut; slow motion only for accent frames; never repeat one action across shots; environmental feedback is part of the action; landing/rising needs its own shot; hold 0.3s of stillness after the action

blocks.label: FIRST / LAST FRAME CONSTRAINT
blocks.zh: 首尾帧强约束（21 条，择要）：①首帧必须是「静止的构图」而非动作中间态 ②尾帧必须是可继续的稳定姿态 ③首尾帧共用同一 GEO 平面 ④首尾帧角色数量必须一致 ⑤首尾帧风格前缀逐字相同 ⑥尾帧不得出现新角色 ⑦尾帧不得引入新光源方向 ⑧首尾帧画幅比例一致 ⑨首尾帧景别差异 ≤ 一级 ⑩禁止首尾帧之间做空间跳转 ⑪过渡动作必须写明起点与终点 ⑫描述两端之间的唯一变化量 ⑬首帧动作幅度必须小于尾帧余量 ⑭禁止尾帧出现运动模糊 ⑮禁止首帧出现运动模糊 ⑯首尾帧都需要写明相机站位 ⑰尾帧留出下一镜的入画空间 ⑱首尾帧色温一致 ⑲禁止尾帧出现画外元素 ⑳首尾帧的服装状态必须一致 ㉑两端之间只允许一个物理事件
blocks.en: Twenty-one first/last-frame constraints (abridged): the first frame is a still composition, never a mid-action instant; the last frame is a resumable settled pose; both share one GEO floor plan; identical character counts; identical style prefix verbatim; the last frame introduces no new character; no new light direction; identical aspect ratio; shot-size delta at most one step; no spatial jump between the two ends; state the transition's start and end; describe the single change between the ends; first-frame amplitude must be smaller than the last-frame headroom; no motion blur on the last frame; none on the first frame either; both name the camera position; the last frame leaves entry room for the next shot; matched color temperature; no off-screen elements in the last frame; identical wardrobe state; exactly one physical event between the ends

blocks.label: AI TRANSITION — MEDIUM COVER
blocks.zh: AI 转场「介质掩护」铁律：**绝对禁止**让两个物理形态差异巨大的实体直接发生形变。形变发生时必须引入符合全局基调的**过渡介质**掩盖计算过程——镜头光斑（lens flare）、运动模糊（motion blur）、粒子爆散（particle burst）、烟雾、水花、雨幕、翻页、遮挡物扫过。介质必须：①与本片美术基调一致 ②在形变前 2-4 帧进入 ③在形变后 2-4 帧退出 ④不得遮挡主体关键信息。典型可用对：人→人（同形态，直接过渡）；人→兽（需烟雾/粒子）；室内→室外（需光斑/白闪）；物→人（需遮挡扫过）
blocks.en: AI-transition medium-cover rule: never let two entities with vastly different physical forms morph directly. When a morph happens, introduce a transition medium consistent with the film's art direction to cover the computation — lens flare, motion blur, particle burst, smoke, water splash, rain curtain, page turn, an occluder sweeping past. The medium must match the art direction, enter 2-4 frames before the morph, exit 2-4 frames after it, and never occlude key subject information. Safe pairs: human→human (same form, direct); human→beast (smoke or particles); interior→exterior (flare or white flash); object→human (sweeping occluder)

rules.title: Assets first
rules.zh: 素材先行：角色/场景/道具全部锁定并压力测试之前，不生成任何一个镜头
rules.en: Do not generate a single shot until every character, location, and prop is locked and stress-tested

rules.title: Describe everything, every time
rules.zh: 每次全量描述：模型没有记忆，描述符逐字粘贴、永不缩写
rules.en: The model has no memory; the descriptor goes into every prompt word for word, never shortened

rules.title: Change one thing at a time
rules.zh: 一次只改一处：整段重写会丢掉生效的部分；每次迭代记录日志
rules.en: Rewrite a prompt fully and you lose the parts that worked; one line per iteration, everything into the log

rules.title: Give the model less freedom
rules.zh: 少给自由：角落而非房间、锚点而非空地、地图而非猜测、每镜一个动作
rules.en: A corner instead of a room, an anchor instead of open space, a map instead of guesswork, one action per shot

rules.title: Simplify the shot, not the words
rules.zh: 镜头不出来就简化镜头：拆成两镜、删一个动作、换角度；10-15 次迭代上限
rules.en: If a shot will not come together in 10-15 iterations, split it, remove an action, change the angle

rules.title: The first second is always a wide
rules.zh: 每场第一秒固定广角：无人声无动作，把站位/光线“拍”进模型
rules.en: One second at the start of a scene, no lines and no action: locks positions and light

rules.title: Physics, not adjectives
rules.zh: 写肌肉不写形容词：颤抖、下颌咬紧、颧骨绷紧、鼻息；静止写成“绷住的张力”而非“别动”
rules.en: Describe the work of muscles and body, not emotion words; stillness as held tension, never a freeze

rules.title: The voice is a locked descriptor
rules.zh: 音色是锁定描述符：register/tempo/accent/manner 在 pre-production 锁定，逐次粘贴
rules.en: Lock register, tempo, accent, manner before any dialogue; pasted as-is every time the character speaks

rules.title: Point changes go on with masks
rules.zh: 点修改用蒙版：衣服/伤疤/血在 Nano Banana 改后手工蒙版合回原图；图片绝不全图二过模型
rules.en: Clothes, scars, blood are point changes masked onto the original; an image never runs through a model twice in full

rules.title: Dialogue lives only in the audio block
rules.zh: 台词只在 AUDIO 块：声音+情绪→引号台词→肢体动作→面部反应；无台词者完全沉默
rules.en: Voice+emotion → line in quotes → physical action → facial reaction; everyone else stays completely silent

rules.title: No pronouns in visual description
rules.zh: 视觉描述四维度禁代词：景别/角度/主体/环境四个维度内一律写具体名词，禁止用「他/她/它/他们/它们」指代角色或物体；同一镜内不得出现可指向多个实体的代词
rules.en: Four visual dimensions (shot size / angle / subject / environment) must use concrete nouns. Never use he/she/it/they to reference a character or object; a shot must not contain a pronoun that could resolve to more than one entity

rules.title: Duration is computed from the line, not guessed
rules.zh: 时长由台词推算而非拍脑袋：按台词字数与情绪档位估算，再向上取到模型支持的档位；不要在提示词里写与实测时长冲突的秒数
rules.en: Derive duration from the line length and emotion tier, then snap up to a supported tier; never write a seconds value that conflicts with the measured duration

rules.title: One physical event between the frame ends
rules.zh: 首尾帧之间只允许一个物理事件：超过一个事件时，模型会在中段自选一个执行，结果不可控
rules.en: Exactly one physical event may occur between the first and last frame; with two or more the model picks one mid-clip and the result is uncontrollable

rules.title: Morphs require a transition medium
rules.zh: 形变必须有介质掩护：物理形态差异大的实体之间禁止直接形变，必须用符合美术基调的介质掩盖计算过程（详见 transition_medium_cover 块）
rules.en: Morphs require a cover medium: entities with very different physical forms must never morph directly; hide the computation behind an in-style medium (see the transition_medium_cover block)

recipes.label: FULL
recipes.zh: 完整版配方：包含全部 7 个基础块 + 适用时追加长台词/动作戏/首尾帧块。用于关键镜、开场镜、情绪转折镜
recipes.en: Full recipe: all seven base blocks, plus long-dialogue / action / frame-constraint blocks when applicable. Use for key shots, opening shots, emotional turns

recipes.label: FIRST LINE
recipes.zh: 首行精华版：只保留「风格前缀 + 主体 + 一个动作 + 一个约束」，压到一行内。用于批量过镜、预演、快速试错——不用于终版
recipes.en: First-line condensed recipe: style prefix + subject + one action + one constraint, compressed to a single line. For batch passes, previz, and quick iterations — never for the final take

failureLedger.symptom: 角色串脸（同一角色在不同镜头里脸不一样）
failureLedger.cause: 参考图没有做「身份锚点」声明；或 prompt 里用了代词导致模型重新想象角色
failureLedger.fix: 把角色定妆图排在参考图第一位并显式声明为身份锚点；视觉描述内禁用代词（rule: no-pronoun-visual）；同一角色跨镜粘贴同一段身份描述符

failureLedger.symptom: 长台词镜头里角色嘴型对不上，或说话中途模型自行切走
failureLedger.cause: 单镜台词超过模型可承载长度；模型在长句中途失去「正在说话」状态
failureLedger.fix: 按 long_dialogue_split 的 T1-T7 处理；单镜台词压到 40 字 / 25 词以内；把长句拆成两块 AUDIO 并在自然停顿处切镜

failureLedger.symptom: AI 转场处出现「融化」「粘连」「面团化」的畸形过渡
failureLedger.cause: 两个物理形态差异巨大的实体被要求直接形变，模型只能靠插值硬接
failureLedger.fix: 加介质掩护（镜头光斑/运动模糊/粒子/烟雾/遮挡扫过）；介质需在形变前 2-4 帧进入、后 2-4 帧退出（rule: medium-cover-on-morph）

failureLedger.symptom: 首尾帧生视频的中间段「脑补」出与剧本无关的内容
failureLedger.cause: 首尾帧之间塞了两个以上物理事件，模型自选执行顺序；或首帧不是静止构图而是动作中间态
failureLedger.fix: 首尾帧之间只保留一个物理事件（rule: single-physical-event）；首帧改为静止构图；尾帧改为可继续的稳定姿态（block: frame_constraint）

failureLedger.symptom: 同一场次的镜头空间关系错乱（人物左右互换、门口位置漂移）
failureLedger.cause: GEO 平面图没有逐镜粘贴；或某一镜里改动了相机站位却没写回 GEO 块
failureLedger.fix: 每场锁定 GEO 块逐镜逐字粘贴（rule: describe-everything）；跨 180° 轴线必须写「轴线切换」并在两镜之间插入中性过渡镜

failureLedger.symptom: 动作戏糊成一团、肢体交叠、武器消失
failureLedger.cause: 一镜内塞多个动作；多人同时动作；肢体在画面中交叠产生粘连
failureLedger.fix: 一镜一动作且动作有终点姿态；避免多人同时动作；避免肢体交叠；受击反应放到下一切点（block: action_choreography）

failureLedger.symptom: 画面风格跨集漂移（第一集冷青、第三集偏黄）
failureLedger.cause: 色盘只存在于想象中，没有逐字复用；每集重新描述色调
failureLedger.fix: 在 palette.json 里声明主色与扩展色，生成时机械注入同一字符串；扩展色不得超过 2 个（见 film-kit/palette.json）

failureLedger.symptom: 生成结果「看起来对但就是不对味」，反复重试无效
failureLedger.cause: 提示词过长导致中段约束被模型忽略（长 prompt 的注意力衰减）
failureLedger.fix: 改用 firstline 配方快速定位问题维度，再用 full 配方补齐；一次只改一处（rule: one-change-at-a-time）；超过 10-15 次迭代就简化镜头（rule: simplify-shot）

glossary.zh: 视频生成模型（Seedance 2.0，剧情镜头主力）
图片生成模型（Nano Banana 2，角色定妆/素材图）
电影感图片模型（氛围/质感图）
引用令牌：<<<uuid>>> 形式的资产引用，逐字保留
glossary.en: Reference token: <<<uuid>>> asset reference kept verbatim

glossary.zh: 角色定妆三视图：面部特写 + 正面无头全身 + 背面全身
glossary.en: Character sheet: face close-up + headless front full-body + back

glossary.zh: 地理空间布局块（每场锁定，逐镜粘贴不变）
glossary.en: Geo spatial layout block (locked per scene)

glossary.zh: 身份锚点：参考图列表的第一张，用于锁定角色面部身份；其余参考图只允许提供环境与光影
glossary.en: Identity anchor: the first reference image, locking the character's facial identity; the remaining references may only supply environment and lighting

glossary.zh: 尾帧提示词：描述本镜结束时画面的稳定状态，作为下一镜（或首尾帧生视频）的输入
glossary.en: End frame prompt: describes the settled state of the frame at the shot's end, used as input to the next shot or to first/last-frame video generation

glossary.zh: 过渡介质：掩盖形变计算过程的画面元素（光斑/烟雾/粒子/模糊/遮挡物）
glossary.en: Transition medium: an in-frame element (flare, smoke, particles, blur, occluder) that hides the morph computation

glossary.zh: 失败模式台账：症状→原因→修法的可检索记录，改提示词前先查这里
glossary.en: Failure ledger: searchable symptom → cause → fix records; check it before editing any prompt
